summary: Full backend + frontend test pass on iteration 15. All 19 pytest cases PASS (auth login/register/guest/google, voice rooms CRUD + join/leave + end, WOTD claim idempotency, vocab-hub languages/levels, play flag-match XP endpoint). Frontend playwright validated: /auth segmented Login/Signup toggle + Forgot-password-only-in-login + Google redirect to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=... + Guest one-tap flow lands on /connect. Play mini-game plays through 10 questions, correct answer highlights green, finish screen shows correct score×2 XP math. Voice /voice FAB opens Create-Room modal with all fields (title/language/mode/topic/private/announcement) — backend already validated create+join+leave. Chats top shortcuts (courses, voice, play, more sheet) all navigate correctly to /lessons/learn, /voice, /play, and open the More sheet with 8 secondary items. Vocab-Hub renders exactly 15 language chips, all 3 level buttons load lessons (11 Beginner lessons for Spanish). Word-of-Day widget present on /chats.

ui_bugs.issue: On a 390x844 mobile viewport, the 'Create Room' submit button sits below the fold — Playwright error 'Element is outside of the viewport' when clicking. Users must scroll the create-room sheet. Not a blocker (scroll works), but consider making the sheet content fit or the submit button sticky at the bottom for one-tap creation.

issues: Submit button not visible without scrolling on iPhone-SE-sized viewport (390x844) — sticky footer with the CTA would improve completion rate.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning repeated across screens: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — cosmetic-only on web preview, harmless on native, but worth a sweep to migrate remaining shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow to silence warnings and align with react-native-web latest.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — from an internal component. Non-blocking but should be tracked.

action_items: Consider sticky/pinned 'Create Room' submit button so it stays in view on small phones (390x844) — currently below the fold.
Migrate remaining shadow* props to boxShadow across screens to eliminate deprecation warnings (cosmetic).
Track down and fix props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents deprecation (single internal component).

Voice call (1-on-1 chat WebRTC) audio streaming cannot be validated via Expo web preview — needs a native dev build to fully test microphone + peer connection. Code paths (call context, ringing/answer/decline endpoints) exist and endpoints respond — recommend real-device QA before release.
Room audio streaming (react-native-webrtc inside voice rooms) similarly needs a native build — CREATE/JOIN/LEAVE/END are fully validated at the API level and the UI wiring is present.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx: solid — testIDs on all interactive elements, Emergent OAuth playbook followed (hash-parse on web mount, WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync on native, ref-guard against re-processing same session_id).
rooms.py: clean — no _id leakage (uses `id` in room_summary/room_detail), proper 403/404 handling, gift ledger + diamond credit atomic-ish.
wotd/today/claim: correctly idempotent (checks existing claim by day_key before awarding XP). Verified via test.
play.tsx: awards XP via /vocab/lessons/play-flag-match/complete — good reuse of vocab XP pool. Best-effort try/catch silently swallows errors which is fine for a game.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on flows tested via web preview

seed_data_creation: Created + auto-cleaned one voice room (TEST_IT15 Voice Room) and one register user (test_it15_*@example.com) during the pytest run. Room was ended via API; user remains but is harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend for auth (login/register/guest/google-endpoint-validation), voice room CRUD/join/leave, chats shortcuts, play mini-game, vocab hub, and WOTD widget presence all verified working.
